name: codex-delete-then-recreate
description: Codex deletes a file in one turn and adds a file with the same path in the next. The new file starts from nothing: no line inherits the deleted file's origin (rule 3). One of the new lines has exactly the text of a base line (`return 1`), but content equality never transfers origin (rule 1), so every line of the final file is p2.
